🎉 PichiPie TV v2.3.0 Major Update!

✨ What's New:
• 🏟️ Dedicated Daily Live Sports Hub — Brand-new widescreen 16:9 match cards, instant category filtering (Football, Cricket, Combat/UFC, Racing), quick server switcher, and clean team matchup titles!
• 🎨 Symmetrical Cinematic Splash Screen — Re-imagined brand identity with central glowing icon, sleek electric cyan typography, and smooth choreographed animations.
• 📺 Multi-Row 3-Card Balanced Grid — Clean 3 cards per row across Live TV, Sports, and Movies with uniform card dimensions and tailored descriptions.
• 🔥 PichiSports & Daily Sport Unified — Exact same card dimensions and spacing across all sports servers.
• 👑 PichiPie Premium & 24/7 Sports TV — PichiPie Premium is now your #1 live TV network, and Football & CricHD feature dedicated Sports TV headers.
• ⚡ 0ms Lag-Free Movie Caching — Instant catalog navigation, chunked batch loading, and flawless remote D-Pad controls across 25,000+ movies.

Enjoy the next-generation entertainment experience with PichiPie TV v2.3.0!
